notes: S-1 filing (SEC), filed May 20, 2026. Pre-IPO prospectus, not an earnings call. Financial data covers Q1 2026 and FY 2025/2024/2023.

signal_evidence.services_demand: Starlink Subscribers totaled approximately 10.3 million as of March 31, 2026, up approximately 105% from 5.0 million subscribers a year prior, across 164 countries, territories, and other markets.
signal_evidence.capex_direction: For the three months ended March 31, 2026, capital expenditures for our Space segment was $1,052 million, for our Connectivity segment was $1,332 million and for our AI segment was $7,723 million—total of $10.1B in a single quarter versus $4.1B in Q1 2025.
signal_evidence.pricing_power: Our Starlink Subscriber monthly ARPU decreased from $86 per month for the three months ended March 31, 2025 to $66 per month for the three months ended March 31, 2026, driven primarily by international expansion and the addition of lower priced service plans.
signal_evidence.management_tone_shift: We believe we have identified the largest actionable total addressable market ('TAM') in human history... We were the first company to deploy a coherent gigawatt-scale AI training cluster... We believe orbital AI compute is an incredibly difficult technical challenge that only we can solve at scale in the near term.
